title: Associated graded ideal sheaf algebra from multiplication of representatives
statement: For a scheme X and a quasi-coherent ideal sheaf I, form B_n=I^n/I^(n+1) as in [def-weil-pbc-formal-kernel-graded-pieces]. There exists a graded sheaf algebra A [def-weil-pbc-graded-sheaf-structures] on B with unit the degree-zero quotient projection. For all degrees m,n, all opens U, and sections a of I^m and b of I^n, there exists c in I^(m+n)(U) with inclusion ab and A.mul of their quotient classes equal to the quotient class of c. No formal module or finiteness assertion is involved.

source.place: Lemma 087Z, affine proof via Lemma 087W and Section 0EHN; constituent of the parent existence proof, expanded in the Lean docstring.

proof.text: On affine opens identify the ideal powers and their quotient sections with powers of the section ideal and their algebraic quotients. Multiplication descends because changing a representative contributes to I^(m+n+1). Include degree zero using the identity power inclusion.

The affine operations commute with restriction. Lift quotient sections locally on an affine cover and glue independent products by the sheaf condition. Check the unit, associativity and commutativity locally on common representatives. Products of actual power-ideal sections lift uniquely through the monic power inclusion and glue to the required c on any open.

proof_origin.place: Lemma 087Z, construction and affine proof; local-lift and sheaf descent details expanded by Q3.

lean.statement:
theorem formalAssociatedGraded_algebra_exists {X : Scheme.{u}}
    (I : X.IdealSheafData) :
    ∃ A : GradedSheafAlgebra (formalAssociatedGradedPiece I),
      A.unit = formalAssociatedGradedπ I 0 ∧
      (∀ (m n : ℕ) (U : X.Opens)
        (a : (Scheme.idealSheafPower I.toModulesι m).1.val.obj (op U))
        (b : (Scheme.idealSheafPower I.toModulesι n).1.val.obj (op U)),
        ∃ c : (Scheme.idealSheafPower I.toModulesι (m + n)).1.val.obj (op U),
          (Scheme.idealSheafPower I.toModulesι (m + n)).2.val.app (op U) c =
            (@id Γ(X, U) ((Scheme.idealSheafPower I.toModulesι m).2.val.app (op U) a)) *
              (@id Γ(X, U) ((Scheme.idealSheafPower I.toModulesι n).2.val.app (op U) b)) ∧
          A.mul m n U ((formalAssociatedGradedπ I m).val.app (op U) a)
            ((formalAssociatedGradedπ I n).val.app (op U) b) =
              (formalAssociatedGradedπ I (m + n)).val.app (op U) c)
